description.value: This study examined global and regional cortical volume, thickness, and area in adults with combat-related posttraumatic stress disorder and subjects without PTSD using FreeSurfer-based cortical surface analysis, and tested whether cortical structure mediated associations between WAIS scores and PTSD severity.

spans.text: Taking advantage of recent advances in the structural analysis of magnetic resonance images, this study revisited the status of cerebral cortical tissue volume in the same sample of 99 Vietnam and Gulf war veterans our group reported on previously.

description.value: The sample comprised 50 participants with PTSD and 47 subjects without PTSD, including Vietnam and Gulf war veterans, with structural MRI acquired at two sites; the study was observational and cross-sectional.

spans.text: The sample for this study included 97 of 99 participants reported on in 3 previous articles describing regional brain volumes in adult combat-related PTSD.
